observed_error: Status: Preparing for write: Ensuring mountns: Reading /proc/1/ns/mnt: Permission denied (os error 13)
analysis: status() calls get_host(); when Environment::needs_mount_namespace() is true, get_host calls prepare_for_write(). ensure_self_unshared_mount_namespace() reads /proc/1/ns/mnt before comparing it with /proc/self/ns/mnt. The collector already has a private mount namespace, but that does not bypass the read. The retained journal proves this operation failed, not which kernel/LSM check denied access.
